reviews.text: Im very happy with Super Star mobile grooming they are the best they did a good Job  with my dog
Tech named Arley is extremely nice and knows how to handle my little dog. Arley is always punctual and takes his time to get it done right.

Well it would have been 5 stars, but my time was wasted. On Tues I made an appt for my dog for Thurs. it was for between 9a-10a. Come almost 10a I call to see if there was a delay. I was told by secretary my appointment was cancelled due to not being able to confirm the day before. I received no calls nothing on Wed. He claims one call was made in the morning one in the afternoon! I received nothing I have 0 missed calls!!! I work afternoon shift so I specifically woke up early to not have an appointment which I’m sure if he made calls wasn’t to my number!

I have used super star grooming for some time and unfortunately this will be the last time ! My dog Hazel went in for a wash and comes back with a “nick” ear cut ! Bleeding so much, they called to tell me they notice she had a cut on her ear that was there prior to and that’s where the cut came from. I responded how is that possible if the blood is from a new area. All they offered was a new wash no refund no discount no nothing not even a sorry!

Terrible service. The people who do the work have absolutely no love or respect for our pets, and they don't know anything about grooming. I think if they do that to a person in a salon they can be sued or at least receive a refund. Pets are part of family. My daughter post photos.

I have never experienced a groomer completely shaving a cat when I specifically requested a trim. And at that a very bad shaving. The groomer explained that my cat had short hair, but I clearly stated that I wanted him to have a haircut/trim, not be shaved. I was told a #10 blade would be used for trimming, yet my cat was shaved almost completely, almost showing skin. This is not what I requested or expected. For future reference, ask them to show you what blade and how much. I am very disappointed with the outcome and the lack of communication regarding how much hair would actually be removed. Groomer had bad attitude, times were changed but actually came whenever they pleased.

I used them for over 4 years but not anymore.   They hardly trimmed my dog even though I showed them a picture of the dog with short hair and requested the same.  My complain after the fact was ignored.   It is time to move on to someone else.

I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction with the recent grooming service provided for my two dogs. The experience was exceptionally distressing. Despite Aracelys' assurance regarding Noel's proficiency, the outcome was unacceptable. My 17-year-old Dachshund and 5-year-old Yorkie both suffered negative consequences.

Following the grooming, my Yorkie exhibited severe anxiety, a behavior unprecedented for him. He also sustained deep cuts around his eyes, which were visibly red. During the grooming of my Dachshund, I observed her trembling and nearly falling from the grooming table, and her cut was severely botched.

I contacted Aracelys, who requested photographic evidence of the issues, which I promptly provided. However, I have not received any follow-up communication to address the situation or an apology. Consequently, I will no longer be using their services and do not recommend them.
I have a year using their service and it’s always been great, fast and reliable. Omar is the one the grooms my 3 dogs and its always great service. I would recommend to friends and family

I will never call them for anything ever again and I recommend you don’t either especially if it is that guy because he is horrible. Their solution to grooming seems to be shaving dogs instead of actually grooming them properly. Certain breeds require skill, scissoring, and proper coat maintenance, but it appears they take the lazy route and just shave everything down, while charging premium prices.

They also advertise services they clearly are not equipped to perform. Something as basic as dental brushing was supposedly included in the package, yet the groomer didn’t even have a toothbrush. That alone should tell you everything about how seriously they take their work.

On top of that, their customer service is TERRIBLE. Once there was an issue - communication suddenly disappeared. Calls were ignored and if they answered they would immediately hang up. ZERO ACOUNTABILITY

A grooming company is supposed to care about animals and take pride in their work. This place feels like the opposite: rushed work, poor service, and no responsibility afterward.

There are many groomers out there who actually care about dogs and know what they’re doing.

This is not one of them.

I am beyond furious over what this company did to my dog.

I have been paying for FULL service grooming for months, and I now realize I was being charged for services that were never actually done. The last groomer admitted he didn’t even have a toothbrush. I had to go upstairs to my apartment, bring my own toothbrush, and make them brush my dog’s teeth in front of me. I have been paying full price for incomplete service this entire time.

Then they shaved my Mini Schnauzer without my permission. I asked for a short trim not a full shave. Anyone who knows schnauzers knows they have a skirt and fuller legs. They removed everything. There were no severe mats. They made that decision on their own.

When I picked him up, he was shaking, screaming, and walking strangely. He clung to me and looked completely distressed. I have never seen him like that.

As a dog owner, nothing is worse than feeling like your dog wasn’t safe in someone else’s care.

To make it worse, they promised a refund and have now ignored my calls for two weeks yet answered immediately when I called from a different number. When I pushed for accountability, I was told to “just use someone else.”

You do not get to overcharge people, skip services, and send dogs home emotionally wrecked. My dog is not a transaction. He is not a shortcut for profit.

If you care about your dog’s well-being, do not bring them here. I wish someone had warned me. My poor baby, before & after pictures....

I was happy with this grooming company until this visit. I had my two mini Goldendoodles, Ginger and Sonny, groomed on Saturday the 31st after my previous appointment was canceled. Since they don’t service the Homestead area, I drove to Cutler Bay.

I explicitly asked for a teddy bear cut and a trim—not too short. What my dogs received was a low possum cut that looks nothing like what was requested. I also clearly stated not to cut their eyelashes, and they were still cut.

The grooming was rushed and careless. When I called Monday to give feedback, I was told the groomer was one of the “faster” groomers—which now makes perfect sense.

My dogs are my pets and my children. This was unacceptable, and I will be finding a grooming company that actually listens, takes their time, and delivers consistent results. I will be uploading photos showing what I requested versus what I received.

They don’t even deserve a star. My Maltese mix puppy was groomed by Super Star Mobile Grooming on 12/21/25 by a groomer named Luis. She was returned to me with uneven  coat all over her body. Luis stated that his clippers were not working properly, which I advised was not my concern as I paid for a complete grooming service. He asked for permission to correct the imperfections, but I declined and contacted the company to speak with a supervisor.

I spoke with someone named Jerisa (spelling may be incorrect), who stated she was sending someone more experienced. When the second groomer arrived, he apologized and informed me that the only way to fix the uneven cut would be to shave my puppy’s coat completely. I requested that this corrective service be provided at no cost; however, Jerisa stated that the company could only offer a $10 discount.

This was an extremely disappointing experience. If you truly care about your fur baby, I strongly recommend avoiding this company.

On Wednesday, October 1st, I booked a grooming appointment for my chihuahua and my other dogs. My chihuahua, Hercules got a shave and he has always been getting shaves for years now because he sheds a lot. I let the groomer, Evelio know that Hercules is sensitive because he is 15 years old and has joint pain. After I got Hercules, he seemed fine and the shave look good.

However, 2 days later, my family noticed puss coming out on his back. We cleaned it and under the puss was an open skin lesion. The next day, the skin lesion got bigger and the puss was progressively getting worse. I decided to then take Hercules to the vet because it was spreading and he was in pain. The vet had immediately told me it was hotspots and that it was caused by the poor grooming. Evelio was too harsh with him and that led to Hercules skin becoming irritated.

Fast forward, Hercules now has a giant skin lesion on his back and is dealing with the pain. He has antibiotics for it and ointment for pain relief on the hot spot. He has to have a cone on until the lesion heals. It hurts to see my dog in pain like that and it was all because of this company. I decided to call the company and tell them nicely as to what was going on because I wouldn’t want this to happen to ANYONE’S DOG. The lady I was speaking to showed no empathy or didn’t even apologize! I didn’t care about the money at all, I care about the other dogs who can go through this terrible thing. She was asking me questions like “are you sure he has been shaved before?” as if I don’t know what services I get for my dog. It was so disappointing to see this company not only do this to my dog but not handle the situation right at all!!

I will never forget the pain my dog is going through now because of this company. DO NOT risk your dog’s health with this grooming company.

I’ve been using this grooming service for 3 years, consistently with Belkys, who was great. Unfortunately, she moved out of town. Last month, I had a gentleman (didn’t get his name) who did a good job and had no real issues. Today, I got a different groomer (Michael???), and while he was polite and did a decent job, the experience left a bad taste.

After receiving my dog  and confirming my usual grooming instructions, I received a call from the company informing me of a $15 upcharge. The guy on the phone claimed my dog is now considered a large dog. I was confused, as my dog has been with this company for 3 years and is only 22 lbs. I asked for clarification and was told small dogs are anything under 30 lbs. I pointed out that my dog is still under 30 lbs.

Then, the story changed.

Now it was because of his breed (Cavapoochon) and the “amount of hair” he has, despite the fact he gets regular cuts (every 2 to 3 months and monthly grooming) and wasn’t unusually hairy today. It felt like they were scrambling to justify an arbitrary fee. If they had said upfront, “Hey, based on today’s coat, there will be a small upcharge,” that would’ve been fine. But this felt sneaky and dishonest.

To be clear, the groomer himself did a good job. Coop looked nice and smelled great. This review isn’t about craftsmanship. It’s about principle. I am not fond of  inconsistent communication and made-up charges. If I’m going to pay more, I’d rather go somewhere with transparency, consistency, and decency.

Sadly, after sticking through rough experiences with groomers before Belkys and remaining loyal all this time, this random upcharge with no clear justification is my breaking point.

Olivia

I’ve been a customer of this mobile grooming company for over a year, regularly booking appointments for my own dog, my father’s dog, and a few friends I’ve referred along the way. The main reason I kept coming back was because of Carlos—he’s an incredible groomer who takes his time, is so gentle with the dogs, and really knows his craft. Our pets always looked great after a session with him.

However, the business side of the company has been a huge disappointment. They constantly have issues with scheduling—appointments would get canceled or no-shows would happen without notice. Every time I called to ask what happened, it was the same excuses: “The system was down” or “The truck broke down.” It became a pattern that was frustrating, especially since we had recurring appointments set up.

Even Carlos himself would tell us that many of his regular clients have left due to the company’s lack of professionalism. It’s a shame because with a groomer like Carlos, they could have had a stellar reputation, but the poor management and unreliable service really drag the whole experience down.

I wouldn’t recommend this company unless you’re willing to deal with the hassle of unreliable scheduling. If Carlos were to ever work independently or with a better company, I’d happily support him again in a heartbeat.

We’ve been using Superstar Mobile Grooming for our miniature schnauzer for some time. While things started off well, our last two experiences have been incredibly disappointing and concerning.

The second-to-last appointment was a complete letdown—our dog was returned to us without a haircut, no nail trimming, and not even a proper bath. He had simply been combed and sprayed with perfume. No explanation was given.

Our most recent experience was far worse. He came back with painful clipper burns on the corners of his eyebrows and cuts along his legs. These injuries were severe enough that he now has to wear a cone until he heals fully. It’s heartbreaking to see him in pain from something that should be routine and safe.

If you love your fur baby, I strongly recommend avoiding this company. The quality and care have drastically declined, and the risk is just not worth it.
